angle: It constructs the standard error as the standard deviation of repeated n equals 5 mouse-sample means with overlaid sampling pictures, then walks a complete six-step resampling recipe for estimating it from a single sample.
angle_detail: Start with [04:00]-[05:47] for the core intuition that means cluster tighter than raw data, then follow [08:46]-[11:11] for the full bootstrap walkthrough resampling five values with replacement and taking the deviation of the resulting means. Use the formula shortcut at [08:13]-[08:25] only for the mean case and bootstrap everything else, noting the aside that bootstrapping ideally wants ten or more measurements. Confidence-interval construction is explicitly deferred, so pair this with the follow-up interval video.
